entries.decision: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.249, and Eclipse Temurin 21.0.12.1+1-LTS x64 HotSpot for the control.
entries.basis: Authoritative artifact metadata and local byte/runtime verification on 2026-09-01.

entries.decision: Keep the control baseline's mods directory empty and do not admit candidate JARs before Item 3.
entries.basis: Candidate inventory is tentative and its full exact compatibility audit is a dependent Item 3 obligation.
User authorization recorded in handoff; flags are construction-only and not a production allocation.

entries.decision: Use seed 8953077177248245348 solely as the baseline reconstruction/proof seed.
entries.basis: Handoff supplied it and runtime restart/restored-world seed commands matched it; it is not yet one of the Item 4 deterministic test-seed suite.

entries.decision: Close Item 2 only after durable remote evidence and commit/push/tag receipts are recorded.
entries.basis: The GitHub release assets were downloaded into a fresh directory and matched both expected hashes and sizes; evidence commit 40ebd9ac4beb3258d1ab3b88e7941da0bf5f5548 was pushed and tagged.

entries.decision: Do not publicly upload the complete installed-server archive; publish the state overlay and raw-evidence bundle, and reconstruct installed software from exact authoritative inputs.
entries.basis: The full archive contains redistribution-restricted Mojang and NeoForge software. A clean-room reconstruction from the pinned inputs plus state overlay already proved operational equivalence.
